title: Looking Back: My Path to {company}
practice: Léela en voz alta 3 veces. Luego grábate 1 minuto contándola sin mirar.

rows.en: When I started at {company}, I **had** already **worked** for {prevJob}.
rows.es: Cuando empecé en {company}, ya había trabajado en {prevJob}.

rows.en: **While** I **was working** there, I learned a lot.
I **hadn't worked** at a company like {company} before.
rows.es: Nunca antes había trabajado en una empresa como {company}.

rows.en: At first, I **was learning** something new every day.
rows.es: Al principio, aprendía algo nuevo cada día.

rows.en: During {project}, the team **was working** very hard.
rows.es: Durante {project_es}, el equipo estaba trabajando muy duro.

rows.en: **While** my coworkers **were working**, I **was updating** the progress report.
rows.es: Mientras mis compañeros trabajaban, yo actualizaba el reporte de avance.

rows.en: I **had worked** with {work} before, so the job wasn't new to me.
rows.es: Ya había trabajado con {work_es}, así que el trabajo no era nuevo para mí.

rows.en: I **was** already **working** at {company} when I started this English book.
rows.es: Ya trabajaba en {company} cuando empecé este libro de inglés.

dialog.text: What were you doing when the fire alarm went off?
I was updating a report in the office.
Had your team left the work area?
Yes. They had already stopped working.
Good. What did you do then?
I left the office and went to the meeting point.

pron.en: I hadn't worked at a company like {company} before.
At first, I was learning something new every day.
pron.pron: ət FERST, ai wəz LÉR-ning SAM-thing NIU É-vri DEI

pron.en: What were you doing when the alarm went off?
pron.pron: WOT wer yu DÚ-ing wen dhi ə-LÁRM went OF

check: Cuento mi historia en menos de 1 minuto, sin leer, uso was/were + -ing para la escena y had + participio para lo anterior, sin decir "I was knowing".
